# DiskSelectionStrategy

Supported disk selection strategies.

| Characteristic | Value  |
| -------------- | ------ |
| Type           | `enum` |

## Variants

### variant-1

Select the smallest eligible disk that fits the layout.

| Characteristic | Value          |
| -------------- | -------------- |
| Type           | `string`       |
| Value          | `smallest-fit` |

### variant-2

Apply device-family priority before comparing disk capacity. Check eligible disks by Linux device-name family, in this order:

1. NVMe (`nvme*`)

2. SCSI/SATA-style disks (`sd*`)

3. Virtio disks (`vd*`)

4. Non-removable eMMC user-area disks (`mmcblk*`)

5. Legacy IDE-style disks (`hd*`)

Choose the first family that contains a disk large enough for the configured storage layout, then select the smallest fitting disk within that family. Move to the next family only if no eligible disk in the current family fits.

Capacity is not compared across families: a fitting NVMe disk is chosen even if a smaller fitting `sd` disk is available.

| Characteristic | Value                 |
| -------------- | --------------------- |
| Type           | `string`              |
| Value          | `tiered-smallest-fit` |
